title: Explosion (Meme)
blurb: Big-budget, clean, and entirely disproportionate to whatever prompted it — a proper cinematic detonation rather than a cartoon puff of smoke. Metaphorical explosions are everywhere once you start looking: an argument concluding badly, a secret arriving in a group chat, somebody hitting reply-all on a company-wide email at four in the afternoon. All of those are, technically, explosions. Pair it with a slow zoom onto a single face for maximum devastation, and resist the urge to cut away too quickly. Let the debris settle. That is where the comedy is.
origin: A cinematic explosion for metaphorical detonations everywhere.
